Character: human
Approved pick: /home/minipuft/Applications/claude-prompts-mcp-showcase/media/showcase/v3/studies/human-gen-16-swoop.png
Board cards: seuss-archbishop-katz, midnight-gospel-junkyard, style-board (D44), eagle-msra13489b3xt (Boondocks model sheet, line discipline), eagle-ms6v3zad9jlic (cloak figure)
Production root: media/showcase

Read `v3/creative-spec.md` (D65–D72 and the Craft baseline section: the model sheet is the identity contract; the clean-up standard) and `v3/rubric.md` (C20–C22). Generate ONE model sheet through the `imagegen` tool (`tool:imagegen`), never by hand: `references` are the absolute paths of the pick and the cited card files; the `prompt` asks for a pure black field, five flat colors with identity pigments by hex, pale contour one step lighter, and this layout at one scale on one baseline: row 1 turnaround front / three-quarter / side; row 2 the same three views as construction volumes (spheres, cylinders, wedges) with a proportion ruler in heads at the left; row 3 the expression states neutral, blink, open mouth, look (D70) and a hands row (open, point, grip, hold); every cell numbered. `out` is `out/<character>-model-<NN>.png`. Measure on the plate: head count per view, limb lengths per view as ratios of height, scale agreement between views (reject above 5 % and regenerate once naming the drift), contour weight in px against 1/120 of figure height ± 20 %, taper and closure (C22). Lay the sheet and its measurements into the `ModelSheet` composition and render one still. Write `assets/<character>/model.json` (views, heads, limb ratios, contour weight, sha256 of the plate, the generation receipt). Cut nothing here. Do not pick: the owner approves the sheet from the still, and until then it is provisional.

Return: Views (cell, measured heads and ratios); Scale Agreement; Clean-up Measured; Sheet Path; model.json Path; Generation Receipt; Rejected Generations; Concerns.

---
